display_name: US and UK wholesale price indexes, 1790-2010

triage.reason: Faithful reconstruction of Shaikh Figure 5.4 (Ch5) plus a documented US extension. Two book-period country lines (1790-2010, 1930=100) read directly from Shaikh's Appendix 5 DATALRprices workbook, with an optional US PPI continuation (FRED PPIACO/WPU00000000, anchored at 2010); the UK extension leg is left empty because ONS PLLU is unreachable, not substituted with a proxy. Parent series of S501/S503/S504; the empirical centrepiece of Ch5's post-1939/40 fiat-inflation argument.
